verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents replaying archived events or backfilling history into a newly added or repaired destination. Warehouse Sync (x4) only ingests data from a customer's own warehouse into mParticle. That is an adjacent ingestion feature, not a documented replay or backfill capability, so it earns no credit here. The other items (forwarding, feeds, integrations) are titles or general claims with no replay content.
